messages:
rachel-se: Heads-up - FinSecure flagged two blockers in their enterprise review: require HSM-backed KMS + VPC-only for any PII processing. They also reported intermittent slow first-token latency during a 20-minute demo. Can Eng/Ops help triage and we also need a quick pricing note for a dedicated trial?
tom-eng: pinged. Can you paste the runtime snippet and what model + request shape they used? Long system prompt or many turns?
sam-cs: From the customer: single long init prompt (~10k chars) + two user messages, streaming enabled. Observed first token ~1.6s, occasional spikes to 3.1s under multi-seat demo. No sustained 429s but saw transient quota_exhaustion once.
rachel-se: here's a client excerpt they pasted into chat: ```
HTTP POST /v1/streams gen auth=token-redacted
{"model":"rwd-gen-xlarge","prompt":"<long security-policy + context>","max_tokens":400,"stream":true}
RUNTIME: req=rs_91b2
RUNTIME_LOG: batch_size=1, batch_tokens=620, kv_cache_hit=false
RUNTIME_LOG: cache_evictions=14, kv_cache_ttl=25000ms
RUNTIME_LOG: first_token_ms=1608, avg_ms_per_token=26
RUNTIME_LOG: quota_event: transient.quota_exhausted -> customer=finsecure
```
priya-ops: quick read: batch_tokens 620 > tenant max_batch_tokens -> single-item scheduling. KV TTL quite small so multi-turns rebuild. Also a 25000ms TTL means the prefix cache likely evicted between demo steps.
tom-eng: agreed. I checked tenant config: finsecure had a legacy presales tweak setting batching.max_batch_tokens=128 while global is 512. That 128 + 620 token request guarantees single-item batches. Also their tenant burst pool is small (burst_credits=50) which explains the transient exhaustion under concurrent seats.
priya-ops: ops can temporarily apply overrides: bump batching.max_batch_tokens to 1024 for tenant=finsecure and increase kv_cache_ttl to 180000ms. Safe flag enforced; no service restart.
sam-cs: customer also asked whether using Private with HSM KMS would change latency profile or if Dedicated reserved capacity is recommended for demo week.
tom-eng: HSM KMS itself doesn't materially change inference latency — key unwrap occurs during init and is cached. The bigger TTFT contributors here are batching and cache behavior. Dedicated reserved capacity helps with burst stability and removes shared tenant burst contention, but it has commit cost. For a 1-week heavy demo, we can offer a short-term reserved pool (week-long) with higher burst credits; we'll need Pricing to quote.
priya-ops: I've applied tenant overrides now: batching.max_batch_tokens=1024, kv_cache_ttl_ms=180000 for finsecure. Also enabled a diagnostic trace flag for batch-assembly on region eu-central-1 for their requests. infra-log: override_id=ovr_339a applied at 2026-04-02T14:12:09Z by ops-runner.
kms-bot: note: FinSecure requested HSM attestation docs. See /console/security/kms#hsm-attest (internal link). Generated runbook ID kms-run-78 for legal.
tom-eng: next steps on engineering: 1) monitor req rs_91b2 and subsequent traces for first_token_ms; 2) add a short warmup recommendation to SE: send a 32-token warmup request per seat before full demo to populate KV cache; 3) if they maintain long static policy text, suggest storing it in KV prefix entries and reference by id in the prompt to reduce batch size.
rachel-se: I'll relay warmup + KV guidance. Also customer wants quick pricing: what's the delta cost if we bill their week as a reserved trial vs pay-as-you-go with a temporary burst pool?
priya-ops: for a week sandbox we can create a dedicated reserved slot sized at 2x their nominal throughput with a daily cap. Ops estimate: add-on flat fee $3,000 + per-token at committed rate (negotiable). I'll loop in Pricing formally.
sam-cs: customer reran demo after override. Preliminary feedback: first token ~420ms median, occasional ~650ms under 8-seat concurrency, no further quota_exhausted events. They're happy with perf; still awaiting KMS docs for contract language.
priya-ops: rollback plan: override will be kept for 48 hours then reviewed. If they upgrade to Dedicated we'll set these as defaults.
tom-eng: leaving traces on for 72 hours, will capture any regressions. If we still see single-item batches despite the override, we'll instrument batch-merging heuristics.
rachel-se: legal wants the KMS/HSM attestation and runbook before signature. Sam, can you confirm campaign to share kms-run-78 and intro to Private onboarding?
sam-cs: done. Shared runbook and private onboarding checklist. Also requested timeline from FinSecure for decision.
rachel-se: thanks everyone — I'll compile notes and ask Pricing for an official one-week reserved quote. Closing once contract and KMS docs are acknowledged by FinSecure. :white_check_mark:
